verdict.rationale: Shortwave offers team comments and @mention to loop teammates into a thread (giving them access to the email) and custom AI filters that can label/archive/star via plain-English rules, but there is no evidence of an explicit 'assign conversation to teammate' ownership feature or rule-based routing of incoming mail to specific team members/inboxes. missing for 10: explicit conversation assignment/ownership feature, mail routing rules tied to teammates, evidence of shared/team inbox queue management.
